verdict.rationale: Postman's first-party docs say it runs scripts before a request is sent (pre-request) or after (post-response). Those scripts can add dynamic parameters and pass data between requests, which covers chaining requests and massaging data, and the Postman CLI runs these collections in CI/CD. missing for 10: in-depth scripting API documentation (e.g. how values are read and written between requests, controlling request order), independent or hands-on corroboration of scripted request chaining.

support.subject: As a developer, I can script pre-request and post-response logic to chain requests and massage data

citations.quote: Postman can run scripts before a request is sent (pre-request) or after (post-response).
Write scripts to add dynamic behavior to requests and collections. Perform API tests, add dynamic parameters, pass data between requests, and more.
You can also use the Postman CLI to run test collections as part of your continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.
